title: Find out what is stopping the Mac from going to sleep
summary: When the Mac stays awake, an app or background process may be holding a power assertion that blocks sleep. This command lists those apps and processes.

aliases.text: что мешает маку уходить в сон
какое приложение не дает mac уснуть

steps.explain: Show the power assertions held by apps and processes. An assertion is a request to keep the Mac awake; each process that holds one is listed with its name.
steps.expect: Lines such as PreventUserIdleSystemSleep 1 mean sleep is blocked; the process name next to it shows which app holds it. Value 0 means nothing blocks that sleep.

source.title: pmset manual; card written and verified in the lnxhelp sandbox
